messages:
Priya (Marketing): Heads-up: need a compact 'Enterprise Deploy Snapshot' one-pager for Tuesday's webinar. Focus: security posture, SLA tiers, expected unit cost ranges, and handoff instructions for field. Keep it skimmable and shareable.
Omar (Product): include 3 recommendation boxes, 2 benchmark callouts (label them example workloads), and migration path. Also small note on runtime fallbacks and quantization options.
Nina (Field): must call out KMS/HSM, VPC, audit retention options (90/180/365d), and compliance examples (SOC2, HIPAA). Add one Financial Services example.
Chris (Sales): inbound routing logic - SDR -> AE -> SE; want simple triggers. Also one-line CTA for launch post.
Priya (Marketing): proposed structure:
- Header: 1-line problem + Risk / Speed / Cost pill
- Core: 3-column comparison table (Hosted | Dedicated | Private) with rows: Security controls, SLA/Latency, Cost profile, Time to ship
- Side: 2 benchmark callouts + 3 persona microcopy
- Footer: Routing rules + webinar CTA

Omar (Product): benchmark notes (example workload):
- Hosted: 95th-pctl ~100-130ms at 1k qps with 128 tokens
- Dedicated: steady-state 30-45% lower unit cost at >1M tokens/day with reserved GPUs
Add: runtime supports KV caching and auto-model-fallbacks.

Nina (Field): persona snippets:
- Platform Lead: "Dedicated for predictable throughput + private VPC."
- CISO: "Private with customer KMS and audit logs meets regulatory needs."
- PM: "Hosted for fastest time-to-market, streaming and tool support."

Chris (Sales): routing pseudo-rules (ops-ready):
```yaml
if requires_hsm or data_residency == true or compliance in ["HIPAA","PCI","FedRAMP"]:
  route: AE+SE (high-touch)
elif projected_tokens_per_day >= 1_500_000 or expected_qps >= 800:
  route: AE (dedicated)
else:
  route: SDR -> nurture
```
asset-bot: uploaded 1747123345-enterprise-deploy-snapshot-v0.pdf

Priya (Marketing): copy constraints: <140 words main blurb, approachable tone, conservative performance claims, two-tone header. produce accessible PDF + single-slide.
Omar (Product): minor change: call out "SLA-backed latency tiers" for Dedicated, Hosted described as "best-effort with multi-region fallback". add sentence on migration Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private.
Nina (Field): I'll paste FS example and discovery one-liners in next message.
Chris (Sales): locking CTA: "Not sure which deployment fits your risk profile? Book a 15-min infra consult: https://redwood.ai/book-demo". will draft AE playbook snippet after copy finalizes.
Priya (Marketing): owners + deadlines:
- Priya: write one-pager & slide (EOD today)
- Omar: fact-check numbers + blurbs (tomorrow AM)
- Nina: FS example + discovery one-liners (tomorrow noon)
- Chris: routing YAML to ops + AE snippet (tomorrow afternoon)
- Design: final assets after copy (24h)
Omar (Product): ack. I'll validate numbers.

Chris (Sales): noted. will send routing to ops.
Priya (Marketing): thanks. goal: final for webinar pre-read on Friday. ping for blockers. :white_check_mark:
